messages.note: The scheduler consults in-memory slot cache knowledge when using slot policies.

messages.note: For slot workers, the gateway injects id_slot and cache_prompt; it also injects W3C traceparent.

messages.note: The gateway preserves the upstream response type and treats non-SSE responses honestly.

cards.title: Explicit absences
items: No authentication or authorization middleware was found on the chat-completions route.
No request database, durable request state, or request-persistence fallback was found in the request path.
The diagram includes those participants only to make their non-implementation unambiguous; they receive no messages.

cards.title: Cache semantics
items: This is scheduler-maintained slot cache knowledge, not a separate Redis-like request cache.
A slot policy records dispatches and prices reusable prefix tokens; a miss is represented as zero reusable tokens.
There is no cache-to-persistence fallback in the observed code.

cards.title: Evidence inspected
items: apps/gateway/src/main.rs: request handler, scheduler selection, upstream POST, SSE/JSON response handling, and traceparent injection.
crates/scheduler/src/lib.rs: slot cache view, reusable-token pricing, and dispatch recording.
apps/gateway/src/telemetry.rs: OTLP is optional and exports traces/logs through configured providers.
